economic_hypothesis: A strict upward true gap means the market abandoned an entire price interval overnight. When that interval is at least one percent, occurs after a bounded sixty-session inventory regime, carries participation expansion, closes high, and is not a locked limit-up, the gap is a tradable information-repricing event whose next sessions may continue discovering a higher equilibrium.

causal_state.history: 60 prior symbol rows exist; all 20 most recent rows are hard-valid/current-valid/tradable.
causal_state.bounded_inventory: prior-60 minimum coordinate low / maximum coordinate high >=70%.

trigger.strict_true_gap: signal coordinate low is strictly above the immediately prior market-session coordinate high, and their market-session indices are adjacent.
trigger.meaningful_gap: signal coordinate low / prior coordinate high - 1 >=1%.
trigger.signal_return: signal step return is between +5% and +12%, inclusive.
trigger.participation: signal turnover >=1.5 times the preceding-20-row mean turnover.
trigger.not_limit_up: signal coordinate close is strictly below the legal upper-limit coordinate.
trigger.deduplication: qualifying events separated by no more than 20 market-session indices form one symbol cluster; retain its first event.

profile_selection: 2014-2018 only: maximize median annual mean net return, then pooled mean, then shorter horizon.
confirmation: Only the selected profile is evaluated on 2019-2021; require average completed trades/year >50, pooled mean net >3%, pooled median >0, and every confirmation-year mean >0.
